clauses.text: the Battery page of Settings on a laptop shows its three switches (read only)

steps.do: Open Settings, Battery on a laptop on battery power, then plug the charger in.
steps.expect: The bar, the status line and the time change with the charger, and the percentage switch adds or removes the number in the top bar.
